question:
Today, Elizabeth went to the movies. Between what times could they have gone?
We know that:
Elizabeth woke up at 5am.
Sarah saw Elizabeth getting a coffee at the cafe from 5am to 3pm.
Susan saw Elizabeth working out at the gym from 3pm to 4pm.
John saw Elizabeth buying a phone at the electronics store from 4pm to 6pm.
Tiffany saw Elizabeth waiting at the train station from 6pm to 7pm.
Andrew saw Elizabeth waiting at the airport from 7pm to 8pm.
The movies was closed after 9pm.
Between what times could Elizabeth have gone to the movies?
Options:
(A) 8pm to 9pm
(B) 4pm to 6pm
(C) 5am to 3pm
(D) 6pm to 7pm

segments.text: We need to find possible times Elizabeth could have gone to the movies, given the sightings.
She was seen at various times.
She could have gone to the movies after all sightings?
Sarah saw Elizabeth getting coffee at cafe from 5am to 3pm.
That means she was at cafe during that entire interval?
Or Sarah saw her at some point between 5am and 3pm.
Usually "saw Elizabeth getting a coffee at the cafe from 5am to 3pm" implies she was at cafe during that time.
So she was at cafe from 5am to 3pm.
Susan saw Elizabeth working out at gym from 3pm to 4pm.
John saw Elizabeth buying phone at electronics store from 4pm to 6pm.
Tiffany saw Elizabeth waiting at train station from 6pm to 7pm.
So she was at train station 6-7pm.
Andrew saw Elizabeth waiting at airport from 7pm to 8pm.
We need times she could have gone to movies.
She must not be at other places at same time.
So movies times must be outside all those intervals.
So she is busy from 5am to 8pm continuously.
Also could she have gone before 5am?
She woke up at 5am, so before that she was asleep.
